title: El castillo: debilidades, alumnos y los tres jefes rediseñados
description: docs/castle.md § Weaknesses, docs/castle-bosses.md (2026-11-21). From the fight tester (Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost): the second year's fillings on the figures and plates, the third year softened when wet, Aurelià's Ritmo and tells, Dirección's told moves and who is left in charge, the Queen's five layers and her crown going out, her two hands and La Pompa as a thing of its own. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.foe = kind => ui.live.foes.find(f => f.kind === kind); window.wet = c => { c.timed = { ...c.timed, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 } }; }; window.closeUp = (id, d) => { const p = window.gerard.game.fighterAt(id); window.gerard.game.frame({ x: p.x, y: p.y + (d || 4.2) * .28, z: p.z }, d || 4.2); };

steps.caption: Second year: each pupil's filling shows through its gum (orange fire, blue water, yellow electricity) and is named on its plate («Relleno: …»). It is weak to what undoes it
A filling up close, lit from inside
They hit with their filling: whoever they struck is left burning, wet or (if wet) in shock

steps.caption: Two layers torn off: two flavours of her crown gone out, and the third layer (filled with water: weak to electricity) on her plate
Her crown, her marker: a flavour goes out with each layer
Las manos: one holds (Atrapar → X, told: whoever holds on is not caught) and one crushes (Aplastar → X). Drawn with the palace minion's model for now
The hand that holds, its own plate and PV
La pompa: a thing of its own in front of her, with its PV and the rounds left on its plate; behind it she takes half. Burst in time it goes off in her face (the palace minion's model for now)
